references.text: God calls to Moses from the burning bush with the double name 'Moses! Moses!' and Moses answers, 'Here I am' – the same pattern as in Gen 22:11.
The angel of the Lord calls to Abraham from heaven a second time after Abraham shows his obedience, and repeats the promises of blessing.
God's angel calls to Hagar from heaven – a close parallel to the angel's call from heaven in Gen 22:11.
God calls to Jacob with the double name 'Jacob! Jacob!' and he answers, 'Here I am' (הנני) – the same pattern as Abraham's call.
The Lord calls repeatedly to Samuel, and Samuel answers, 'Here I am' – a parallel to the repeated call and response of הנני.
Abraham's faith when he was willing to offer Isaac is used as an example of faith in Hebrews.
Thematic parallel: The patriarchs' immediate response to God's call.
Theological parallel: Prophetic attentiveness and response to God's call.
Strong parallel: God's double call and the prophet's attentiveness.
